fields.climate: cold temperate; potentially subarctic but comparatively mild because of moderating influence of the North Atlantic Current, Baltic Sea, and more than 60,000 lakes
fields.terrain: mostly low, flat to rolling plains interspersed with lakes and low hills
fields.resources: timber, iron ore, copper, lead, zinc, chromite, nickel, gold, silver, limestone
fields.farm: milk, barley, oats, wheat, potatoes, sugar beets, pork, chicken, peas, rye
fields.exports: paper, refined petroleum, steel, wood pulp, ships
fields.industries: metals and metal products, electronics, machinery and scientific instruments, shipbuilding, pulp and paper, foodstuffs, chemicals, textiles, clothing
fields.legal: civil law system based on the Swedish model
fields.military: all Finnish men are obligated to serve 5.5-12 months of service within a branch of the military or the Border Guard upon reaching the age of 18 (length of service depends on the type of duty)…
